protocol.label_states: annotated rows only (ADR-0006); unknown and not_applicable dropped
protocol.split: cross-fitted on the out-of-fold validation scores of the Phase 9 head
protocol.threshold_rule: per label, the calibrated score maximising MCC; fold k is scored with thresholds tuned on cross-fitted calibrated scores of the other validation partitions whose calibrators never saw fold k; the frozen thresholds are tuned on the cross-fitted scores of all rows

frozen.scope_label: subset (500), not comparable to DeepLoc or to the Phase 8 full-corpus numbers
